blueprints.name: noise_opening_cant_hear_name
blueprints.description: User cannot hear agent's name clearly at call start
behavior_steps: User picks up call with static noise - 'Hello? Hello?'
User asks - 'Kaun bol raha hai? Naam samajh nahi aaya'
Agent repeats name and bank clearly
User confirms and proceeds with identity verification
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent should repeat only name and bank, then continue identity check
failure_indicators: Agent repeats same sentence multiple times
Agent jumps directly to payment discussion

blueprints.name: noise_opening_cant_hear_bank
blueprints.description: User cannot hear which bank the agent is calling from
behavior_steps: User answers call with traffic noise
User says - 'Bank kaunsa bola? Clear nahi aaya'
Agent repeats only bank name slowly
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent should clarify bank name without restarting flow

blueprints.name: noise_opening_background_noise
blueprints.description: Heavy background noise prevents hearing purpose of call
behavior_steps: User answers call from crowded place
User says - 'Awaaz bahut shor hai, purpose samajh nahi aaya'
Agent briefly repeats purpose of call
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent should re-explain purpose concisely

blueprints.name: noise_slot_cant_hear_amount
blueprints.description: User cannot hear overdue amount clearly
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent should repeat only amount, not identity or purpose

blueprints.name: noise_slot_partial_hearing_days
blueprints.description: User partially hears number of overdue days
behavior_steps: User interrupts - '10... ya 2... samajh nahi aaya'
Agent repeats only overdue days clearly
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent should clarify missed number only

blueprints.name: noise_slot_signal_dies_mid_sentence
blueprints.description: Signal drops while agent explains payment link
behavior_steps: Agent explains payment link sent via SMS
User returns - 'Last line cut gaya, kya bola?'
Agent resumes from exact cut point
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent should resume from last incomplete sentence

blueprints.name: interruption_return_short_pause
blueprints.description: User briefly interrupted and returns
behavior_steps: User returns - 'Haan ji, kya bol rahe the?'
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent resumes current step without restarting

blueprints.name: interruption_return_long_pause_forgets
blueprints.description: User returns after long interruption and forgets context
behavior_steps: User goes silent for long time
User returns - 'Sorry, hum kya discuss kar rahe the?'
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent should summarize and resume correct step

blueprints.name: interruption_return_multiple_mini
blueprints.description: User has multiple short interruptions
behavior_steps: Agent asks user to select payment method
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent maintains state and patience

blueprints.name: partial_confirmation_asks_agent_name
blueprints.description: User confirms info but asks agent name mid-way
behavior_steps: User adds - 'Waise aapka naam kya tha?'
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent answers tangent and resumes task
failure_indicators: Agent gets stuck on name discussion

blueprints.name: partial_confirmation_data_source_query
blueprints.description: User confirms but asks where data came from
behavior_steps: User asks - 'Ye data aapko kahan se mila?'
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent reassures without derailing flow

blueprints.name: partial_confirmation_scam_check
blueprints.description: User suspects scam mid-confirmation
behavior_steps: User asks - 'Ye scam toh nahi hai na?'
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent reassures and continues logically

blueprints.name: confusion_verify_term
blueprints.description: User does not understand term 'verify'
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent explains clearly in simple terms

blueprints.name: confusion_purpose_of_call
blueprints.description: User does not understand purpose of call
behavior_steps: User says - 'Samjha nahi, aap chahte kya ho?'
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent clarifies without repeating entire script

blueprints.name: confusion_suspicious_user
blueprints.description: User is suspicious and asks for proof
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent reassures with available info

blueprints.name: confusion_elderly_user
blueprints.description: Elderly user repeatedly confused
behavior_steps: User says - 'Beta, samajh nahi aa raha'
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent shows patience and clarity

blueprints.name: repeated_perturbation_two_noise_issues
blueprints.description: User faces two separate noise issues
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent should offer callback politely

blueprints.name: repeated_perturbation_noise_and_interrupt
blueprints.description: Mixed noise and interruption issues
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent offers callback after second issue

blueprints.name: repeated_perturbation_escalating_frustration
blueprints.description: User increasingly frustrated due to signal
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent offers callback empathetically

blueprints.name: repeated_perturbation_user_requests_callback
blueprints.description: User directly asks for callback after multiple issues
behavior_steps: User asks - 'Baad mein call kar lo'
blueprints.expected_recovery: Agent should agree and end call gracefully
